india.one_line: India rolls out AI data‑sharing handbook and telecom guidelines as a startup secures major funding.

themes.title: New AI policy initiatives
themes.text: MeitY issued a DEPA handbook to guide trusted data sharing for AI training, while TRAI released draft guidelines requiring telecom operators to classify AI systems, obtain board approval and report serious incidents.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms

themes.title: CapGrid secures funding for drones
themes.text: CapGrid raised ₹50 cr in a pre‑Series B round, valuing the company at ₹430 cr, to develop precision components and expand into drone manufacturing and data‑centre markets.

stories.headline: CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
